scenarios.name: receipts_complete_a_witnessed_inception
scenarios.note: An inception needing two of three witnesses arrives with none. A witness's indexed signature, then another witness's receipt couple, arrive as receipts before it is accepted; each is matched to the waiting event, and the second completes it.

scenarios.name: receipts_and_duplicates_for_accepted_events
scenarios.note: An inception accepted with one of two witnesses gains the other's signature by receipt, a stranger's receipt couple, and the second controller signature when offered again. A receipt for another event at the same number is stale, and a different interaction at an accepted number is likely duplicitous.

scenarios.name: receipt_completes_a_rotation_changing_witnesses
scenarios.note: A rotation cutting one witness and adding another arrives signed by the added witness only; a receipt from a remaining witness, indexed into the new set, completes it.

divergence_attached_witness_couple.name: attached_witness_couple
divergence_attached_witness_couple.note: An inception carries one witness's indexed signature and the other witness's receipt couple. keripy stores the couple as a plain receipt, because `processAttachedReceiptCouples` compares the couple's key against prefix objects; the port stores it as that witness's signature.
